title: Kissed Crunchy Egyptian Chicken Kebabs
description: A yeasty and snappy Egyptian dish featuring yellow curry paste, perfect for a date night, and friendly for those who avoid onion and garlic. This recipe is a delicious and flavorful deep-fry treat.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, curry paste, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and mix until the chicken is well coated with the yogurt mixture.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, paprika, and yeast.
Remove the chicken from the yogurt mixture, allowing any excess to drip off.
Dredge the chicken pieces in the flour mixture, shaking off any excess.
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the chicken kebabs in batches until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes per batch.
Drain the kebabs on paper towels and serve hot.
